widgets_values:
**Picture groups dial + Dial Rack + Pika H3 Flex + de-rope (MAINodes)**

Group A (top row) and group B (bottom row): any number of pictures, any sizes. Drag a picture onto a Load Image node, or connect another Load Image to the next free a / b socket; a new socket appears each time. Equal counts pair by position and report an agreement score; unequal counts compare the group averages.

Make Dial from Pictures turns group B minus group A into a dial, feeds it straight into the rack as row "dial_0" (negative strength moves toward A) and saves it as dials/my_picture_group_dial.

framing: how the pictures are read. picture prompt (your own wording), content, look, bare, or all averaged. Try a few and keep what steers best.

Picture dials are weaker than text dials, so start around -4 / +4. Pass 2 de-ropes the jerky stretches; Audio Recover keeps pass 1's original audio.
